environment.instrument_bias_source: workstream B/GB, 13 House-G-US corpus cycles with results attached

governor.no_control_stake: 36 governorships confer no collective majority, so there is no control probability to report -- only how many are won.

overrides.basis: Daniel J. McKee won in 2022 and is not on the ballot
Kristi Noem won in 2022 and is not on the ballot

prior.source: engine/backtest/fit_prior_sigma.py — prior-only residuals pooled over 2018, 2020, 2022 at every horizon
prior.chamber_ratios_note: house 1.0 by construction. SENATE IS ASSERTED AND NOW TESTED (engine/backtest/senate_prior.py): measured at 1.400 on 99 Senate races against 1201 House districts over 2018, 2020, 2022, clustered se 0.416. The asserted value is kept because the measurement does not disagree with it — three cycles of Senate maps cannot separate the two — not because it was never checked. Re-run the module when a fourth cycle exists. GOVERNOR IS STILL ASSERTED AND UNTESTED: MEDSL's governor file is behind a Dataverse guestbook, and governors are cut from the model.

senate_ratio_fit.sigma_house_note: the DENOMINATOR of the ratio, measured under a realised environment; not PRIOR_SIGMA and not a substitute for it

votehub_races.used_for: every candidate-level poll in the model

electindex_gb.used_for: the national environment, and so the prior for 465 unpolled races

electindex_races.used_for: the only polling in 45 races, and every independent's polling

movement.reason: No comparable earlier run: the method changed, so there is no movement to explain.
